item.text: I found that `clusterSession` is currently TTL cached as a whole, so it retains request-specific dial closures and remote-site state. I’m changing the cache to hold only credentials, while continuing to serialize session setup; each request will build its own connection/session wrapper. The Kubernetes service startup also needs to create the streaming directory because that directory is consumed by the forwarder’s async streamer.
